hypothesis: Full attention-pair work and scalar remainder work may need simultaneous features. Replacing shared query size with the second attention feature tests whether their combined explanatory value outweighs the omitted query-linear costs.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * (hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1])
pcvs.name: attention_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Captures attention matrix work across the complete context.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * attn.heads * hidden_states.shape[1] * ((hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) % 16)
pcvs.name: attention_tail_elements
pcvs.rationale: Separately captures scalar remainder work that complete attention-pair counts do not explain.

pcvs.expression: hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] * attn.inner_dim if rotary_emb is not None else 0
pcvs.name: rotary_elements
pcvs.rationale: Retains independent linear scaling for the more expensive self-attention path.
